purpose: Compute the preregistered randomized-block performance statistics and causal execution mechanisms across the exact 69+21 composed Gate-6 source.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only audit of 30 V9 decision traces and snapshots after V3R completes and seals.
approval.confirmation_reference: Standing autonomous authorization for the fixed full-paper scope.

sampling.effective_units: All 30 V9 cases, one per checkpoint seed in each block; every valid causal frontier event is retained.
sampling.source_composition: The complete tunnel_env23 block and original indices 77..89 come from V3R; all other 69 cases come from the sealed predecessor. No partial case077 artifact is read.
sampling.selection: No event deletion and no checkpoint, parameter, block or performance-outcome selection. One later live-probe case is deterministically nominated only by the earliest frame at which both diagnosed causal mechanisms have appeared; ties use case ID.

method.main: Map only the finalized V2 status in deep memory copies into the frozen randomized-block analyzer; independently validate exact row/target/path/traversal schemas and traversal-event bijection, quantify both graph defects, and nominate one outcome-blind live probe.
method.baseline: No-GT mechanism audit; original M-TARE remains the primary performance baseline in the separate 90-case statistical analysis.
method.fallback: None. Any malformed trace, snapshot, source mapping or seal fails the audit.
method.thresholds: Only the already frozen waypoint-lookahead and minimum-event-travel scales are reported; no new tuned threshold.

evidence.expected: Two exact source seals, a 90-case source manifest, frozen seven-metric ten-block statistics, four direct generator hashes, 30 trace/snapshot pairs, all causal events, an outcome-blind probe nomination, RUN_STATE and seal.
evidence.pass: Exactly 90 composed summaries enter the unchanged ten-block analyzer, 30 V9 cases and 60 trace/snapshot files pass exact causal contracts, and zero forbidden reads or mutations occur.
evidence.fail: Any source, seal, source-map, generator, case, trace, graph, event or aggregate mismatch.

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only CPU JSON audit; no ROS, Gazebo, GPU or bag decompression.
